name: Bernd Lange - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the approval of amendments to the International Cocoa Agreement
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees to changes to the International Cocoa Agreement, a deal between cocoa-producing and cocoa-importing countries. The changes make the agreement last indefinitely, with a review every five years. They also tie it to the Sustainable Development Goals, add the goal of a living income for cocoa farmers, and add new measures on economic, social and environmental sustainability. The Parliament's consent is needed before the Council can approve the changes.

- The cocoa agreement would no longer expire; it would be reviewed every five years.
- Cocoa farmers, the cocoa trade and the environment are the focus of the new goals.
- The Council can now approve the changes, and then they take effect.
